title: Blood Rites (novel) — Before Philosophy Got Polite #Shorts
description:
Evolution does not optimize for happiness — Blood Rites (novel) shows exactly where that breaks. Blood Rites is the 6th book in The Dresden Files, Jim Butcher's continuing series about wizard detective Harry Blackstone Copperfield Dresden. After accidentally acquiring a stray puppy from a kidnapped litter of Tibetan temple dogs, Harry Dresden accepts a job from his White Court acquaintance, Thomas Raith, to investigate a series of deaths on a pornography film set led by director Arturo Genosa.

Nobody designed the part of Blood Rites (novel) you experience — it was inherited. Lara Raith: a White Court vampire and the most favored child of the White King. At the start of the book she doesn't realise that she and her family are vampires, but Dresden makes Lara promise to tell her the truth.
